name: Sparse Voxel Set (SVS)
definition: A traversal method that creates an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) for each voxel intersecting the surface and builds a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) for GPU ray tracing hardware.
summary: Sparse Voxel Set is a ray-tracing acceleration method for SDF grids that builds a BVH from surface-intersecting voxels, offloading traversal to GPU hardware to reduce shader workload.
